title: BlockFlow JSON report
description: What Reports → Export JSON writes (schemaVersion 1). Generated by scripts/reportSchema.ts.

droppedSteps.description: Steps not kept because the run was very long.

error.description: Why the run failed or stopped, in one line.

parentRunId.description: Set when a Run Workflow block started this run.

usedDebugger.description: This run acquired a Chromium debugger session (CDP).

mode.description: M5: how the run was started: traced, debug run, or Run from here (the node it started at).

nodeId.description: Id of the node in the stored workflow.

sourceId.description: Id of the node in the file it was imported from, when it differs or came from a file.

status.description: handled = failed, but the step setting "on error" dealt with it.

input.description: Data as it left or entered the block (secrets masked). Large payloads become {"$preview": "…", "$size": n}.

output.description: Data as it left or entered the block (secrets masked). Large payloads become {"$preview": "…", "$size": n}.

port.description: The output the result was sent from.

locator.description: The locator the failing step used.

url.description: URL of the page when the step failed.

matches.description: For locator.strict: the elements that matched, described.

screenshot.description: Id of a screenshot (not embedded in JSON).

childRunId.description: For Run Workflow: the run of the called workflow.

console.description: Bounded page console and exceptions, secret values masked.

trace.description: M5.1 trace of a step (traced run, or the step setting `trace`). Picture ids are like `screenshot` (not embedded in JSON).

before.description: Id of the picture taken before the block ran.

after.description: Id of the picture taken after it finished.

box.description: The element the step acted on, in CSS pixels of the viewport (the picture shows the viewport).

viewport.description: Viewport size in CSS pixels when `box` was measured.

network.description: Requests during the step, when the run already had a debugger session on the tab (metadata only).

failed.description: Failed to load, or HTTP status 400 and up.

errorCode.description: What kind of failure it was. Set whenever `error` is.

oneOf.description: No element matches the locator (within the step timeout). Fix: Check the locator against a page snapshot; wait for the page or the element first.
The locator matches more than one element where exactly one is needed. Fix: Make it more specific (see `matches`), or add `>> nth=0`.
The locator cannot be parsed (bad CSS, unknown engine, bad regex). Fix: Fix the locator syntax.
The element exists but stayed hidden (display:none, hidden, zero size). Fix: Open whatever reveals it first (menu, tab, accordion), or wait for it.
The element stayed disabled. Fix: Fill in what enables it first, or check the right element is targeted.
The field is read-only. Fix: Target an editable field.
Another element (an overlay, a cookie banner) sits on top of it. Fix: Close the overlay first, or use `force` on Click.
The element kept moving (an animation). Fix: Wait for the animation to end.
The element cannot do this: typing into a button, selecting on a non-select, checking a non-checkbox. Fix: Use the block that fits the element, or target the real field.
The select has no such option (or it is disabled). Fix: Use one of the options the message lists.
The step ran out of time waiting for something other than an element (text, URL, a response, a popup). Fix: Raise the step timeout, or wait for the right thing.
An Assert did not hold. Fix: The page differs from what the test expects: fix the expectation or the steps before it.

A Screenshot with "compare" differs from its baseline by more than the allowed share of pixels (or has another size). Fix: Open the step in Reports: if the new look is right, press "Accept new baseline"; mask regions that change on their own.
HTTP Request got a non-2xx answer with "fail on error" on. Fix: Check the URL, method, headers and body.
HTTP Request could not reach the server. Fix: Check the URL and the host permission.
A page did not load (or the tab never finished loading). Fix: Check the URL; raise the timeout for slow pages.
No tab of that name in this run. Fix: Put an Open Tab block (with that tab name) before the step.
The tab was closed while the step used it. Fix: Do not close the tab mid-run, or open it again.
The element is inside a frame the extension cannot reach. Fix: Check the `frame=` part of the locator; the frame may not have loaded.
The browser does not let extensions script this page (chrome://, the web store, about:). Fix: Use a normal web page.
An optional permission (host access, debugger, userScripts, downloads) is not granted. Fix: Grant it on the block or in the extension settings.
A download was interrupted or cancelled, or its content cannot be read (Wait for Download). Fix: Check the link works in a normal tab; to read the file, its address must still be reachable.
Run Script code threw. Fix: Fix the script; the message has its error.
The secrets are encrypted and the passphrase has not been entered this session. Fix: Open the BlockFlow editor, go to the Secrets page and enter your passphrase.
A setting is missing or invalid (a required field, a bad URL, a template that does not render). Fix: Fix the block setting the message names.
A workflow called by Run Workflow failed. Fix: Open the called run (`childRunId`) and fix its failing step.
Any other failure. Fix: Read the message.
